sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's nickel dominance for EV batteries and energy storage will structurally drive renewables demand, despite short-term policy headwinds.
Geothermal expansion, supported by PLN's grid integration targets, offers a durable, baseload renewable advantage over intermittent solar/wind in Southeast Asia.
US IRA-driven clean energy investments (e.g., VST, NRG) create a spillover catalyst for Indonesian climate-tech via technology transfer and carbon credit markets.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables lag (-2.82%) vs US resilience (-0.11%) signals a tactical watch: buy MPOW's +3.92% momentum on nickel-based battery supply chain and BEP's +2.70% geothermal exposure, as global clean energy demand decouples from local policy uncertainty.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Deep-value distressed consumer plays are gaining traction as institutional investors rotate out of overvalued staples into names with asymmetric upside on balance sheet restructuring.
Palm oil-based FMCG sub-sector faces structural margin erosion from rising CPO costs and weakening export demand, pressuring OILS and related names.
Indonesia's domestic consumption recovery is bifurcated: premium segments (KLIN, OPMS) benefit from urban affluence, while mass-market names (TSCO, MEJA) struggle with rural purchasing power erosion.
sectors.ai: Aggregate consumer/FMCG weakness masks extreme dispersion: AGAR's +24.75% surge signals deep-value rotation into distressed names, while US-listed drag persists. Buy AGAR on follow-through volume for tactical alpha; short OILS as palm oil margin compression accelerates.
